app.name: TrainHub
app.tagline: The place that connects personal trainers with trainees

landing.title: The system that runs your entire personal training business
landing.subtitle: Schedule, trainees, training requests, payments and reports — all in one place, in Hebrew, English and Russian.
landing.feature_schedule_desc: Set your working days and hours, block off time, and receive training requests with zero double-booking.
landing.feature_patients_desc: Add trainees by phone number and track the details that matter to you before every session.
landing.feature_payments_desc: Track daily, weekly, monthly and yearly revenue, broken down by cash, Bit or PayBox.
landing.feature_holidays_desc: Reminders for your trainees' and trainers' birthdays, plus every Israeli holiday in one place.
landing.for_trainers_desc: Manage all your trainees, your schedule and your revenue in one place.
landing.for_trainees_desc: Find your trainer, request a session in an open slot, and track your requests.

auth.role_trainer_desc: Manages trainees, a training schedule and payments
auth.role_trainee_desc: Looking for a personal trainer and wants to book sessions
auth.reset_password_desc: To reset your password, verify your identity with your phone number, last name and date of birth as registered.
auth.reset_password_success: Your password was updated successfully. You can log in with your new password now.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.no_slots: You haven't added any time slots yet
schedule.no_slots_available: This trainer has no available time slots right now

patients.title: My trainees
patients.no_patients: You haven't added any trainees yet
patients.confirm_delete: Remove this trainee from your list?

places.title: Training places
places.name: Place name
places.details_hint: e.g. court, field or room number
places.pick_on_map: Pick a location on the map
places.pick_on_map_desc: Click the map to mark the exact spot (optional).

profile.title: Public trainer profile
profile.specialty_placeholder: e.g. tennis, swimming, football, general fitness
profile.description_placeholder: Tell trainees about yourself, your experience and your method
profile.required_parameters: Details to request from trainees before a session
profile.required_parameters_desc: e.g. resting heart rate, previous injuries, fitness level
profile.cost_per_hour_hint: The total cost will be calculated automatically based on the session length
profile.public_profile_desc: When checked, your profile (including rating and reviews) appears on the public trainers page that anyone can browse.

trainee.no_trainers: You haven't been added by a trainer yet. Ask your trainer to add you using your phone number.
trainee.request_sent: Request sent successfully and is awaiting the trainer's approval
trainee.dual_calendar_hint: Since you're a trainer too, times when you already have a commitment are greyed out below.
trainee.you_are_busy: You already have a commitment at this time

account.title: My account
account.verification_desc: Upload a photo of your ID document and take a live photo with your camera to get a "Verified" badge next to your name.
account.camera_error: Couldn't access the camera. Make sure the browser has permission.

publicTrainers.title: Trainers & ratings
publicTrainers.subtitle: Browse trainers with a public profile and read reviews from other trainees
publicTrainers.no_trainers: No trainers with a public profile yet
publicTrainers.swipe_done: You've gone through all available trainers
publicTrainers.swipe_hint: Swipe right to like, left to skip
